name: Meprylcaine
summary: Meprylcaine (also known as Epirocaine and Oracaine) is a local anesthetic with stimulant properties that is structurally related to dimethocaine.

pharmacology.text: Meprylcaine has a relatively potent inhibitory action on the monoamine transporter and inhibits the reuptake of dopamine, norepinephrine and serotonin.

uses.text: Meprylcaine (also known as Epirocaine and Oracaine) is a local anesthetic with stimulant properties that is structurally related to dimethocaine.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects as a stimulant. Local anaesthetics of its kind can cause numbness, a racing heart and anxiety, and too much can cause seizures and dangerous heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它作為興奮劑的作用所知甚少。同類的局部麻醉劑可能引起麻木、心跳過快與焦慮，過量時可能造成癲癇發作與危險的心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它作为兴奋剂的作用所知甚少。同类的局部麻醉剂可能引起麻木、心跳过快与焦虑，过量时可能造成癫痫发作与危险的心律问题。

fact.en: Like cocaine, the first local anaesthetic, meprylcaine also blocks the reuptake of dopamine, which is why it has stimulant effects as well as numbing ones.
fact.zh: 和最早的局部麻醉劑古柯鹼一樣，meprylcaine 也會阻斷多巴胺回收，所以它除了麻醉之外還有興奮作用。
fact.zhHans: 和最早的局部麻醉剂古柯碱一样，meprylcaine 也会阻断多巴胺回收，所以它除了麻醉之外还有兴奋作用。
